test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Once the seminar was over, the host __gave up__ the certificates to the active participants.
solution:
The correct answer is: **gave away.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"gave up"** typically means to stop doing something; to surrender or relinquish. (छोड़ देना)

 
 
• **Example: **He gave up smoking after his doctor advised him to quit for his health.
 
 
 
• **"gave away"** means to distribute something for free; to hand something out. (बांटना)
 
 
• **Example: **The charity organization gave away blankets to the homeless during the winter.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct substitution for 'gave up' in the given sentence is 'gave away'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'gave away'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **brought about** (लाना): To cause something to happen.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policy brought about significant changes in the company.
 
 
 
• **came by** (मिलना): To obtain or acquire something.
 
 
• **Example: **It's unclear how he came by such valuable information.
 
 
 
• **put across** (बताना): To communicate an idea or message clearly.
 
 
• **Example:** She put across her point of view very convincingly.
